figurative_meaning_en: The lowly, frivolous hip-swaying dance of courtesans
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মঞ্চে খ্যামটা নাচ করে সবাইকে অপমানিত করল।
এই অনুষ্ঠানে খ্যামটা নাচের মতো হীন কিছু দেখানো উচিত নয়।
example_sentences_in_english: She performed a khyamta dance on stage, humiliating everyone.
Such an event shouldn't feature something as lowly as a khyamta dance.
history: This idiom references the traditional dance styles of bayiji (courtesans) in historical Bengali and Indian performing arts, often associated with colonial-era or pre-colonial entertainment in courts and festivals.
note: The term 'খ্যামটা' likely derives from regional dialects describing hip movements in folk dances.
